title: 数据表管理
objective: 理解建表、修改、约束与事务，不破坏内置模板。

knowledgePoints.title: CREATE TABLE 与约束
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 能够运用本节知识完成：为实验室建立库存表
knowledgePoints.concept: 建表定义字段类型、主键、非空、唯一、检查约束及外键。约束在写入时保障有效性。
knowledgePoints.syntax: CREATE TABLE t (id INT PRIMARY KEY, qty INT NOT NULL CHECK(qty>=0));
knowledgePoints.mysqlSql: SELECT id,qty FROM demo_stock ORDER BY id;
knowledgePoints.sqliteSql: SELECT id,qty FROM demo_stock ORDER BY id;
knowledgePoints.comparison: NOT NULL 不代表非负；CHECK 不替代 NOT NULL。

commonError.example: qty INT CHECK(qty>=0) 期待禁止NULL

knowledgePoints.notes: MySQL 与 SQLite 的类型、主键和约束行为不同；只验证本例子集。

compatibility.detail: 仅在本示例数据与语义范围验证；不代表全部 MySQL 语法兼容。

knowledgePoints.setupSql: CREATE TABLE demo_stock(id INT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,qty INT NOT NULL CHECK(qty>=0)); INSERT INTO demo_stock VALUES(1,10),(2,20);

knowledgePoints.title: INSERT、UPDATE、DELETE
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 能够运用本节知识完成：维护个人实验室库存记录
knowledgePoints.concept: INSERT 新增行，UPDATE 修改匹配行，DELETE 删除匹配行；写操作先确定 WHERE 匹配范围。
knowledgePoints.syntax: INSERT INTO t(cols) VALUES(vals); UPDATE t SET col=val WHERE p; DELETE FROM t WHERE p;
knowledgePoints.mysqlSql: SELECT id,qty FROM demo_stock ORDER BY id;
knowledgePoints.sqliteSql: SELECT id,qty FROM demo_stock ORDER BY id;
knowledgePoints.useCase: 维护个人实验室库存记录
knowledgePoints.comparison: DELETE 删除行；DROP 删除表结构；UPDATE 无 WHERE 会修改全部行。

commonError.correction: UPDATE demo_stock SET qty=25 WHERE id=2

knowledgePoints.notes: 只在隔离副本运行，不改内置题库。

compatibility.detail: 仅在本示例数据与语义范围验证；不代表全部 MySQL 语法兼容。

knowledgePoints.setupSql: CREATE TABLE demo_stock(id INT PRIMARY KEY,qty INT); INSERT INTO demo_stock VALUES(1,10),(2,20),(3,30); UPDATE demo_stock SET qty=25 WHERE id=2; DELETE FROM demo_stock WHERE id=3;

knowledgePoints.title: ALTER TABLE 与 DROP TABLE
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 能够运用本节知识完成：为个人数据集补充字段
knowledgePoints.concept: ALTER 修改表结构；DROP 删除表。某些结构修改需重建数据表或转换引擎语法。
knowledgePoints.syntax: ALTER TABLE t ADD COLUMN label VARCHAR(80); DROP TABLE t;
knowledgePoints.mysqlSql: SELECT id,label FROM demo_stock ORDER BY id;
knowledgePoints.sqliteSql: SELECT id,label FROM demo_stock ORDER BY id;
knowledgePoints.useCase: 为个人数据集补充字段
knowledgePoints.comparison: DELETE 不删除结构；DROP 不保留数据。

commonError.example: 直接 DROP 内置库表
commonError.correction: 先复制到个人库并备份

knowledgePoints.notes: MySQL ALTER 的 MODIFY/CHANGE 等形式不等同 SQLite；DDL 常触发隐式提交。

compatibility.detail: 仅在本示例数据与语义范围验证；不代表全部 MySQL 语法兼容。

knowledgePoints.setupSql: CREATE TABLE demo_stock(id INT PRIMARY KEY); INSERT INTO demo_stock VALUES(1); ALTER TABLE demo_stock ADD COLUMN label VARCHAR(80); CREATE TABLE disposable(id INT); DROP TABLE disposable;

knowledgePoints.title: 事务、COMMIT 与 ROLLBACK
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 能够运用本节知识完成：验证库存变更是否正确提交
knowledgePoints.concept: 事务将一组写操作作为逻辑单位；提交使修改持久化，回滚撤销未提交的事务修改。
knowledgePoints.syntax: START TRANSACTION; UPDATE ...; COMMIT; 或 ROLLBACK;
knowledgePoints.mysqlSql: SELECT id,qty FROM demo_stock ORDER BY id;
knowledgePoints.sqliteSql: SELECT id,qty FROM demo_stock ORDER BY id;
knowledgePoints.useCase: 验证库存变更是否正确提交
knowledgePoints.comparison: MySQL START TRANSACTION 对应 SQLite BEGIN；MySQL 多种 DDL 隐式提交。

commonError.example: 认为 DROP TABLE 在 MySQL 中总能回滚
commonError.correction: 将 DDL 与 DML 事务分离，并使用备份

knowledgePoints.notes: 演示只涉及 DML；MySQL InnoDB 事务与 SQLite 锁模型不同。

compatibility.detail: 需要明确转换或原生环境验证。

knowledgePoints.setupSql: CREATE TABLE demo_stock(id INT PRIMARY KEY,qty INT); INSERT INTO demo_stock VALUES(1,10); BEGIN; UPDATE demo_stock SET qty=99; ROLLBACK; BEGIN; UPDATE demo_stock SET qty=12; COMMIT;
knowledgePoints.mysqlSetupSql: CREATE TABLE demo_stock(id INT PRIMARY KEY,qty INT); INSERT INTO demo_stock VALUES(1,10); START TRANSACTION; UPDATE demo_stock SET qty=99; ROLLBACK; START TRANSACTION; UPDATE demo_stock SET qty=12; COMMIT;

knowledgePoints.title: 主外键、UNIQUE 与数据完整性
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 能够运用本节知识完成：设计客户与订单等关系并保护引用完整性
knowledgePoints.concept: 主键保证唯一且非空；UNIQUE 约束避免业务键重复；外键要求非空引用对应父记录。
knowledgePoints.syntax: CREATE TABLE child(id INT PRIMARY KEY, parent_id INT, FOREIGN KEY(parent_id) REFERENCES parent(id));
knowledgePoints.mysqlSql: SELECT p.id,COUNT(c.id) AS children FROM demo_parent p LEFT JOIN demo_child c ON p.id=c.parent_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY p.id;
knowledgePoints.sqliteSql: SELECT p.id,COUNT(c.id) AS children FROM demo_parent p LEFT JOIN demo_child c ON p.id=c.parent_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY p.id;
executionSteps: 写入两个父记录及两个有效子记录
knowledgePoints.useCase: 设计客户与订单等关系并保护引用完整性
knowledgePoints.comparison: 两个子行可以引用同一父行；不应把外键一律设为唯一。

commonError.example: 插入没有对应父编号的子记录
commonError.correction: 先创建有效父记录或修正引用

knowledgePoints.notes: 本地连接务必开启外键检查；SQLite 的 PRAGMA foreign_keys 不属于 MySQL。

compatibility.detail: 仅在本示例数据与语义范围验证；不代表全部 MySQL 语法兼容。

knowledgePoints.setupSql: CREATE TABLE demo_parent(id INT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, code VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE); CREATE TABLE demo_child(id INT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,parent_id INT,FOREIGN KEY(parent_id) REFERENCES demo_parent(id)); INSERT INTO demo_parent VALUES(1,'A'),(2,'B'); INSERT INTO demo_child VALUES(1,1),(2,1);

summary: 完成本章后：理解建表、修改、约束与事务，不破坏内置模板。
